Answers worked by hand from the text, not from the code. KORD is the owner's screenshot of 2026-11-14 put back into the data link's form (its words as the reader gave them back, verbatim; its weather groups and approach line stand in for the ones the screenshot does not show); KMSP is the feed's of 2026-11-09 0353Z (engine/crates/radio/src/datis.rs).
